about_the_game:
ULTIMATE AUTO-RPG: THE BLADEMASTER adds 1 new playable class "The Blademaster" and 1 new special party companion "Shaman". By buying this DLC you are first and foremost showing your support for Ultimate Auto-RPG and future development but you also get a load of exclusive bonus content.

PLAYABLE CLASS

  • Duelist
  • Blademaster (Subclass)

PARTY COMPANION

  • Shaman

BLADEMASTER
In the second age during the soul magic wars, the Scepter Order summoned many orcs from the abyss to serve the tower using the ancient portal in the upper chambers. These orcs were granted immortality to become forever slaves to the master of the tower. One of the orcs that arrived during this era was called Urgo. During the battles of the Kinantu Islands Urgo was the only abyss orc to ever break free from the soul magic that kept him enslaved to the tower. When his mind became free he managed to rally the other orcs to this side and build settlements on the island. This is the founding of the first orc settlements in the known world. Kinantu Islands became the orc kingdoms.
